integrity: The explicit zonal/Johnson factorization, modular exclusions, and separating harmonic are reproduced by a standalone exact symbolic checker; no independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is confined to degree-five harmonics on normalized triangle-face centroid orbits of regular simplices with at least seven vertices, and to replacement of exactly one sample by a simplex vertex; no claim about other sample geometries or generic perturbations.
title: Fifth-harmonic interpolation and single-point repair on simplex triangle-centroid orbits
